title: aglaia tomentosa subsp. cordata
intro: Aglaia tomentosa subsp. cordata, commonly known as the Cordate Aglaia, is a plant species in the Meliaceae family. The plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Aglaia tomentosa subsp. cordata include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include limonoids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, that have been shown to exhibit potential anti-cancer and anti-diabetic properties.
